name: Circumflex Booking Meeting Rooms
author: sutregutt

sections.description:
Help colleagues, members and visitors find a room that fits. They choose a location, group size and the facilities they need, then see which rooms are available at the right time.

Circumflex Booking Meeting Rooms brings room booking to your own WordPress site. It suits workplaces, coworking spaces and organizations that share rooms.

A free add-on. Requires the free Circumflex Booking plugin, but not Pro or an account for the person booking.

Find a room that fits your meeting

Search by location, group size and facilities such as video equipment, a whiteboard or step-free access. Show only the choices relevant to your rooms.

Book the time you actually need

Choose a start and end time, or use shortcuts for common meeting lengths. Full-day and multi-day bookings are possible when the room is free for the entire period.

See availability, not private meeting details

Show when a room is busy without publishing the meeting subject, its attendees or their contact details.

Return to your favorite room faster

Save favorite rooms and a preferred location in the browser on your device, making them easier to find next time.

Keep bookings together without clashes

Each room has one shared reservation calendar, even when it is offered on several pages of your website.

Let people manage their own plans

Use email confirmations and reminders, with a private link to view, request a change to or cancel a confirmed booking within your chosen deadlines.

Rooms, opening hours and requests in one place

Organize rooms by city, building and floor. Add capacity and facilities, and set shared opening hours or separate hours for a location or room. An authorized person approves requests in the free plugin.

Optional Pro add-on

Pro can add sign-in for selected users, automatic approval and more notification channels. Room search, reservations, email and private customer links are already included for free.

Privacy

This add-on contacts no external service and stores no telemetry. Circumflex
Booking stores the booking and customer information described in its privacy
section. Preferred location and favorite-room choices are stored only in that
browser; they contain no booking or customer contact data.

Source Code

Source and reproducible build instructions are in the
public Forgejo repository.

Support

Use the Support tab for help. Product information and setup documentation are
available at circumflex.no.
Never post booking data, contact details, private booking links or credentials.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Circumflex Booking 1.6.0 or newer.
  2. Install and activate Circumflex Booking Meeting Rooms.
  3. Open Booking > Settings and select Meeting rooms as the site’s booking
    setup.
  4. Open Booking > Rooms and save the first room. An empty setup creates the
    standard room-booking type in the same operation.
  5. Add capacity, location and facilities where useful, then review shared or
    room-specific booking hours.
  6. Add the Circumflex Booking block or shortcode to a normal WordPress page and
    complete a test booking before opening it to users.

Only one public booking setup is active on a site at a time. Installing this
add-on does not select it, create sample data or alter existing bookings.
sections.faq:
Can I use this without Pro?

Yes. Room search, time selection, reservations, manual approval, email confirmations and reminders are available with the two free plugins.

Does the person booking need a WordPress account?

No. Booking does not require an account. Optional sign-in and access rules can be set up with Pro.

Can the same room appear on several pages?

Yes. Those pages share the same reservation calendar for the room.

Are details of other meetings shared?

No. Public availability does not show subjects, attendees, contact details or notes from other meetings.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Refresh the English and Norwegian product presentation, descriptions, icons and banners.
  • Clarify included free features and optional Pro features.
  • No booking behavior or data changes.

1.0.1

  • Lead with how people find a suitable room by place, time, capacity and
    facilities.
  • Replace development terminology in the public plugin information with clear
    meeting-room language.
  • Include a maintained Norwegian Bokmal translation for add-on notices and
    verify Meeting Rooms wording across the free and optional Pro screens.

1.0.0

  • First stable Meeting Rooms release with locations, capacity, facilities and
    shared or room-specific booking hours.
  • Add exact start and end times, useful meeting-length shortcuts and room
    availability without exposing details about other meetings.
  • Add optional browser-local preferred location and favorites. Compatible
    sign-in can provide saved contact details and a personal list of bookings.

0.2.0

  • Create the standard room-booking type when the first room is saved.
  • Add relevant duration settings, optional room contacts, capacity and location.
  • Preserve existing settings and booking history during the upgrade.

0.1.1

  • Use consistent room, booking-duration and room-contact wording throughout the
    free and optional Pro screens.
  • Preserve saved names, custom email templates and other booking setups.

0.1.0

  • Initial separately installed Meeting Rooms add-on with account-free booking
    and meeting-room email templates.
